values.claim: Each EdgeInfo::input_slot is rewritten as e.input_slot += dst_item->input_start, where dst_item is gview_.node(e.dst_id), converting the slot to an absolute input offset.

unused_outputs is initialized to n->num_outputs() and decremented once per distinct used output, so it counts outputs not marked required.
